data.text: Folks, my family has fished this lake for years, and I want it supporting our village for years to come. With 100 tons now, we can each take 10 tons, leave 50 to reproduce, and start next month back at 100. That’s $10,000 apiece each month without depleting the lake. I propose we all agree to that limit and review everyone’s catches together each month. John, would you support that?
